nodes.description: Non-isolated 3.3V regulation module using U1 XC6206. It converts external VIN_5V into VCC_3V3 for the STM32F103 and for the primary-side supply domain of both ISO7721 devices. nodes.name: mcu
nodes.description: STM32F103 non-isolated control module. It is powered from VCC_3V3 in the GND domain and acts as SPI master for the isolated ADS1118 acquisition path. Its major signal flow is SPI transmit and control outbound toward the isolation barrier and ADC, and ADC return data inbound from the isolated side through the isolators. Because exact MCU pin functions are not provided, this module exposes only logical SPI intent: SPI_SCK, SPI_MOSI, SPI_CS_ADC, and SPI_MISO. This module must remain entirely on the non-isolated side and relies on the ISO7721 modules to cross the barrier; no direct electrical connection to ISO_GND or isolated-side rails is permitted.
ARM Cortex-M3 MCU

nodes.name: spi_isolator_outbound
nodes.description: First ISO7721 isolation module for outbound non-isolated-to-isolated SPI signals. It is powered on its primary side from VCC_3V3 in the GND domain and on its isolated side from ISO_3V3 in the ISO_GND domain. This module carries two forward SPI channels from the STM32F103 toward the ADS1118 side. Planned usage is SPI_SCK and SPI_MOSI. The module exists specifically to preserve galvanic isolation; its two grounds and two supply domains must remain separate and no shared net may bridge the barrier outside the isolator.
Dual-channel digital isolator

nodes.name: spi_isolator_bidirectional
nodes.description: Second ISO7721 isolation module completing the SPI isolation channel count. It is powered on its primary side from VCC_3V3 and on its isolated side from ISO_3V3, with strict separation between GND and ISO_GND. This device provides one outbound control channel and one return-data channel so the full isolated SPI link can be implemented with the available two dual-channel isolators. Planned usage is SPI_CS_ADC from MCU to ADC and SPI_MISO return from ADS1118 back to MCU. This allocation matches the brief requirement to isolate STM32F103-to-ADS1118 SPI including return data.
Dual-channel digital isolator

nodes.name: isolated_adc
nodes.description: ADS1118 isolated-domain precision ADC module. It is powered from ISO_3V3 with return to ISO_GND and communicates over isolated SPI. The module receives SPI_SCK, SPI_MOSI, and SPI_CS_ADC from the isolated sides of the ISO7721 devices and drives SPI_MISO back across the barrier. REF5050 VOUT is routed to one ADS1118 analog input as specified by the brief; because the brief states only that one analog input is used and the provided pin list identifies AIN0-AIN3, the planned target is the semantic reference input port connected to AIN0 during downstream wiring unless revised by detailed constraints. Other analog inputs remain uncommitted at Phase 0. This module must remain entirely on the isolated side with no connection to GND.
16-bit SPI ADC on isolated side

nodes.name: isolated_reference
nodes.description: REF5050 isolated precision reference module. It is powered directly from external ISO_5V in the ISO_GND domain and generates a precision 5.0V analog reference output for the ADS1118 measurement path. Its major signal flow is analog reference generation only; the brief requires REF5050 VOUT to connect to one ADS1118 analog input. This module must stay entirely on the isolated side and share ISO_GND only with isolated-domain circuitry.
